title: LANCE RELOAD TAIL
why: His Lance reload report: the room feedback filter was resonant at its default Q and could sustain a charge or shot indoors. Use a non-resonant filter and cap vault feedback at 0.80.
now: the Lance no longer rings on after a reload

edits.replacement: return {wet:0.62,damp:1400,fb:0.80,n:'vault'}; /* v28.xx (cw-cx-lancetail): keep the enclosed wet sound; its tail now decays below .001 within 1.5 seconds. */
